about.title: O que é o Hopeland Global Checkers?
about.teaser: Hopeland Global Checkers is the world's premier checkers championship — a season-long journey from open regional qualifiers to a live-streamed world final. Every match is judged by a certified referee panel, every player has a path to the top board, and every result is public and verifiable.
